Pricing that does not add up

The Fixture Plan costs 49 dollars per month and includes 10 seats, 100 GB of storage and unlimited projects. Annual billing removes two months from the total.

What is included in the Fixture Plan?

Every Fixture Plan account receives 10 seats, unlimited projects and 100 GB of pooled storage. Support is answered within one business day.

How does annual billing change the price?

Annual billing charges 490 dollars once per year, which is 10 months at the monthly rate. The discount applies from the first invoice.

Can seats be added mid-term?

Seats can be added at any point and are prorated to the day. Removing a seat takes effect at the next renewal.
